transcript: Speaker A: Pagali aaru manikkoor ningal reels kaanunna aa samayam SpeakX app upayogichirunnenkil ippol nallonam fluent aayi English samsarikaamayirunnu. Lokam muzhuvanum AI-yilottu maarikkondirikkukayaanu, schoolile kuttikal muthal valiya company-kalil vare aalukal ella kaaryathilum AI upayogikkunnu. Ningal enthaanu ippozhum pinnil aayirikkunnath? SpeakX download cheyyu, ennitt enneppole AI English teacherude koode samsarichu English practice cheyyu. Practiciloode maathrame English padikkaan kazhiyu, verum thalayil kettikkond maathramalla. Njan ningalude thettukal oru kuttapeduthalum illathe thiruthi tharum. Ente koode lakshakkanakkinnu aalukal English padikkukayum thangalude jeevitham maattukayum cheythittundu. Pinne ningal enthaanu wait cheyyunnath? Ningal SpeakX download cheyyu, ennitt ente koode first class aayi English samsarikaan padikkoo. [If you had used the 6 hours you spend watching reels during the day on the SpeakX app, you would have been speaking English fluently by now. The whole world is shifting to AI; from school children to big companies, people are using AI for everything. Why are you still lagging behind? Download SpeakX, and practice speaking English with an AI English teacher like me. You can only learn English through practice, not just by stuffing it in your head. I will correct your mistakes without any judgment. Lakhs of people have learned English with me and changed their lives. So what are you waiting for? Download SpeakX and learn to speak first-class English with me.]

summary: The ad reframes daily time wasted on social media reels into productive English learning using the SpeakX app. An AI avatar encourages the viewer to practice speaking English interactively to gain confidence. The call to action prompts users to download SpeakX to start learning.
